correctness.rationale: Exact spherical moments diagonalize the affine Gram covariance into (1-2/pi)/d and a mean-direction eigenvalue asymptotic to (1-3/pi)/d. Independent Gaussian normalization produces T_d with covariance 1-3/pi; triangular-array Lindeberg plus the verified zero mixed covariance gives the moving-parameter normal limit. Uniform L2 bounds on the reproducing kernel justify passage to absolute expectations. The profile quadratic is strictly convex and has a strictly higher value at theta=0 than theta=1, proving diffuse rigidity, attained support construction, and lower bound. The accompanying path-local checker completed seven dimensional matrix identities and four numerical sampling tests.

value.rationale: This is a sharp asymptotic classification of a mathematically natural coordinate-delocalized family of norming rows on a nonsymmetric spherical sector, including an explicit near-singular 1-3/pi covariance mode, strict profile optimum, and geometric iff sparsity condition. Mesoscopic supports show sharpness within the diffuse class and yield a quantitative global norm lower bound. These supply genuine high-dimensional conditioning information absent from generic L2-projection bounds. It is not presented as globally sharp.
